summary: The reported December 28 transition, blanket ACE-to-major restriction and automatic grandfathering remain unverified. The current published combined bachelor CPL 30 rule and FAQ residency were already documented in the November 17 review; newly reading them is not a newly adopted policy. Current catalogs returned connector-reported 403 and no current dated exception was established. Preserve existing student awards and progress; do not invent an effective date or retroactively impose a rumor.

evidence.quote: There is no set limit to the number of credits you can transfer into UMPI.

evidence.title: YourPace FAQ baccalaureate residency
evidence.quote: Four-year degree programs (baccalaureate): Students must complete at least 30 credit hours through UMPI. At least 12 of these credits must be in the major, and at least 9 of those 12 credits must be at the upper level (300-level or above).

overallCap.scope: Conditional arithmetic for a 120-credit degree with at least 30 UMPI credits: at most 90 outside applicable credits. FAQ sets no fixed limit on incoming transfer records; this does not establish 90 ACE credits or an exact degree allocation.

residency.scope: Published UMPI baccalaureate minimum; not a maximum on university coursework.

majorResidency.scope: At least 12 major credits through UMPI, including at least 9 of those 12 at 300-level or above. Exact business-program placement remains unverified.

combinedCplCap.scope: Published general bachelor combined CPL category, including ACE-recommended training; already documented November 17. Adoption date and any approved cohort-specific exceptions remain unknown. This is not a separately established ACE-only cap.

product.notes: No unsupported academic policy, receiving equivalency or historical student-record change is authorized by this finding.
